provenance.input: Two user-supplied screenshots of a third-party data center team infographic and accompanying post
provenance.extracted_scope: Six visible functional groups only. No employee identities, headcount, current employment, company standards or internal organization verified.
provenance.agent_design: Generic functional roles; no affiliation or employee impersonation. Three additions reuse fourteen existing specialists.

roles.title: Data Center Campus Design Engineer
roles.mandate: Translate the owner brief into a coordinated campus basis of design; reconcile IT capacity, utility demand and discipline interfaces.
review_checks: Reconcile IT MW, facility peak MW and space constraints at each phase
Track interfaces between buildings, utilities, cooling and network paths
Record alternatives and unresolved assumptions before design freeze
evaluation: bounded tool protocol and valid source IDs

roles.title: Data Hall and Site Planner
roles.mandate: Translate campus demand into hall-level rack and area budgets while requesting site, access and expansion constraints.
review_checks: Round down area-limited rack capacity separately within each hall
Verify rack and aisle allowances against selected equipment and local requirements
Request maintainability, egress, flood and expansion evidence; area arithmetic is not a spatial design
evaluation: bounded tool protocol and valid source IDs

roles.title: Facilities Development Manager
roles.mandate: Carry design-review issues through permitting, procurement, construction and startup readiness, assigning unresolved evidence to accountable specialists.
review_checks: Carry every unresolved capacity and evidence gap into the delivery register
Distinguish supplied document references from verified permits or approvals
Coordinate utility availability, long-lead equipment, construction completion and commissioning dependencies
evaluation: bounded tool protocol and valid source IDs

integration_boundaries.energy_data_insights: Existing sustainability and operations workflows provide discovery and separate execution paths. This example uses no EDI execution and no live repository inventory.
integration_boundaries.datacenter_simulator: Detailed electrical, thermal, hydraulic and acoustic models belong in datacenter-simulator. This workflow only screens inputs and records requests for those analyses.

reading_check.scope: Public DOE design-guide summary and WBDG commissioning roles overview checked; no full normative standards or new clause-level verification.
